method: Read-only EBML/WebM container parser, including sibling boundaries for streaming unknown-size clusters. No transcoding, inserted frames or video alteration.

video.duration_method: Last minus first timestamp plus median positive frame interval; MediaRecorder streaming WebM has no declared duration.

native_decoder_check.interpretation: The available native AVFoundation importer did not recognize WebM/VP9. No ffmpeg/ffprobe binary was found; no decoder downloaded or installed.

limitations: Container/frame payload validation establishes a nonempty actual encoded stream, not successful decoding or visual quality.
Requested recording rate was30fps; observed rate here is computed from encoded timestamps and frame count.
Scene capture excludes HTML HUD/dialogue/nameplates and audio.
Recording performance is separate from normal gameplay benchmark.
